# Theme

**Class:** `UltraCanvasTheme` · **Group:** [Application, windows and dialogs](../Groups/Application-Windows-And-Dialogs.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTheme.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTheme.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasTheme.h"`

## What it is for

The colour roles (light, dark, high contrast or from the host desktop) every element styles itself from.

## Option types in this header

### struct `ThemeRoles`

The roles every themed element reads

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `pressed` | `Color ground, panel, well, raised, hover, pressed` | surfaces, back to front: the window ground and gutters, a panel, an inset well (fields, lanes), a raised surface (headers, menus, buttons at rest), the hover fill, the pressed fill |
| `lineStrong` | `Color line, lineStrong` | hairline dividers; control borders and strong ticks |
| `inkFaint` | `Color ink, inkMuted, inkFaint` | text and icons: primary, secondary, placeholders and disabled |
| `onAccent` | `Color accent, accentHover, accentSoft, onAccent` | the one accent: fills, selection rings; its hover; the tint behind a selected row; text on the accent |
| `danger` | `Color focus, danger` | the keyboard focus ring; destructive actions and errors |

### enum `ThemeTextRole`

The text roles an element's text plays; the size of each is a ratio of the base size (ThemeFonts::ui.fontSize): Body 1.0, Caption 0.92 (the 11 pt of a 12 pt base), Small 0.85, Heading 1.25, Title 1.5; Mono is the monospace font at the body size.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Body` |  |
| `Caption` |  |
| `Small` |  |
| `Heading` |  |
| `Title` |  |
| `Mono` |  |

### struct `ThemeFonts`

The font half of a look: the interface font and the monospace font with their base sizes in points, and the host's text scale over them (the per-window DPI is applied after, by the window).

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `ui` | `FontStyle ui` | Segoe UI 9, SF 13, Cantarell 11, the bundled Ubuntu 12 |
| `mono` | `FontStyle mono` | Consolas, Menlo, the GNOME monospace font, Ubuntu Mono 12 |
| `scale` | `double scale = 1.0` | Windows "Text size", GNOME text-scaling-factor |

### enum `ThemePolicy`

What the application's theme follows (UltraCanvasApplication::SetThemePolicy).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `FollowHost` | the default: FromHost(GetHostAppearance()), again on every host change |
| `Light` | the framework's Light(), the host's fonts |
| `Dark` | Dark(), the host's fonts |
| `Own` | the application sets its theme itself; a provider may build it from the host |
